main_text.l: 4. Ex fructibus calefaciunt caput: Anacardium, Cubebae, nux Moschata.
Thoracem: Amygdalae, Avellanae, Caricae, Cubebae, Ficus, nux Pinea, Dactyli, Uvae passae, &c.
Cor: mala Citria, nux Indica, nux Moschata.
Stomachū: Amygdalae dulces, Been, Charyophylli, nux Moschata, Pinea.
Renes & Vesicam: Amygdalae amarae, baccae Juniperi, Cubebae, nuclei Pini, Uvae passae, Persici.
Uterum: baccae Lauri, baccae Juniperi, Juglans, nux Moschata.
Refrigerant thoracem: Jujubae seu Zyzyphae, Myxae, &c.
Stomachum: Cotoneae, Citrulli, Cucumeres, Cucurbita, Cornus, Cerasa, Limones, Mespila, Mala, mala Aurantia, Granata, Olivae, Pyra, Ribes, Sorba.
Uterum; Cucumeres. Et hæc hacte-nus de plantarum Viribus.

page.notes: The printed "fructibus" and "calefaciunt" are set with ligatures in the scan; the words are given in plain letters. The accent on "Capparés" and the "ē" in "Stomachū" are printed as such. The "Viribus" is capitalised as printed. No marginal notes or footnotes are printed on this page.
